d:
Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ko lekar mujaphpharpur ke bajaron men raunak barhne lagi hai. chhath vrat ki taiyariyon ke bich jahan bajar men puja samagri ki kharidari tej ho rahi hai, vahin bans se sup, daliya, tokri aur dhakiya taiyar karne vale karigron ki vyastata bhi barh gaee hai.
